name: Recraft Studio (Recraft V4.1)
short_verdict: A useful free design-first image workspace: 30 credits refresh every 24 hours, and Recraft V4.1 raster/vector variants are available on the Free plan. The key catch is that free outputs are public, owned by Recraft and not licensed for commercial use.

name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
category: General-purpose, research, reasoning and multimodal AI
short_verdict: A strong free, source-grounded research workspace: ask questions across PDFs, web pages, YouTube and other material with inline citations, then turn sources into briefs, study aids and audio. Standard access includes 100 notebooks and 50 sources per notebook; AI usage is compute-based and its exact prompt quota is unpublished.

name: Adobe Firefly — Animated Cartoon Generator
category: Cartoon, animation, avatars & character creation AI
short_verdict: Best for quick cartoon-style motion tests; free daily generations are limited and the exact allowance can vary.

name: Suno — v6-mini (free-tier music generation)
short_verdict: Strong for trying full AI song ideas free; daily generation allowance is useful, but new free accounts cannot rely on regular downloads and free songs are non-commercial.

name: GitHub Copilot Free
short_verdict: A useful free coding assistant with 2,000 monthly inline completions and GitHub web/mobile chat; chat and agent credits are limited and the exact free allowance is not publicly quantified.

name: Duck.ai — Private multi-model AI chat
category: Hidden gems across any AI category
short_verdict: A useful, often-overlooked no-signup way to compare several major AI models in one privacy-focused chat. Free use has an unpublished daily cap; Pakistan-specific free access was not independently tested.
